reason: A configurable DeepSeek Harness plugin that conditionally appends file-discipline or DeepSeek thought-language guidance to system prompts based on the selected provider and model route.

summaries.en: Conditionally appends file-reading or DeepSeek thought-language guidance to system prompts based on the selected provider and model route.
